ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of child care fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent and detect such fraud.
questions: What are the most common types of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How are agencies working to prevent and detect child care fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the issue of child care fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to address it. It could also provide insights into the challenges faced by agencies in preventing and detecting such fraud.
